# Didoabe Property Company

> Property management information and WhatsApp inquiry forms for landlords and tenants in Uganda. This website is static. Forms prepare a WhatsApp draft; the company receives an inquiry only if the visitor presses Send in WhatsApp.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of property management services and contact options.
- [About Us](/#about): Company information and service scope.
- [Services](/#services): Property management service information.
- [Landlords](/#landlords): Owner information, scenario calculator, and WhatsApp inquiry form.
- [Tenants](/#tenants): Tenant support information and WhatsApp inquiry form.
- [Process](/#process): Property management process overview.
- [Transparency](/#transparency): Sample reporting layout and financial record information.
- [FAQs](/#faqs): Frequently asked questions.
- [Contact](/#contact): Contact details and WhatsApp draft forms.
